newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 8.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on July 8. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The government has issued an economic deregulation package which cuts tariffs on 1,600 items to boost efficiency.

Indonesia has expressed concern over the crisis in Cambodia and is mulling over suggesting a special ASEAN meeting to discuss the issue. The Association of Southeast Asian Nations groups Indonesia, Brunei, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam and Malaysia.
President Suharto has said public complaints about government services were rising faster than those about the private sector.
Indonesia tightens control on visa requirements for Hong Kong passport holders entering Indonesia.
